en.question: What's a small thing a friend once did for you that you've never forgotten?
followUps: Did you ever tell them how much it mattered?
What small thing do you do for the people you care about?

es.question: ¿Qué es algo chico que un amigo hizo por vos y que nunca te olvidaste?
followUps: ¿Alguna vez le dijiste lo que significó?
¿Qué cosa chica hacés vos por la gente que querés?

en.question: How did the people here first meet, and does everyone remember it the same way?
followUps: What was your first impression of each other?
When did you realise you'd end up friends?

en.question: Would you rather have one best friend who knows everything about you, or ten good friends who each know a different side of you?
followUps: Which side of you do the fewest people know?
Which of the two do you have right now?

en.question: What friendship faded away that you still think about?

Do you think they think about it too?

followUps: Who could you call after five years and it would feel like no time had passed?
Which friendship deserves more effort from you?

en.question: On a group trip, would you rather someone else plans everything and you just show up, or you plan it all exactly your way?
en.optionA: Someone else plans, I show up
followUps: Who in this group is the planner?
What's the best trip someone else planned for you?

en.question: What's the best advice a friend ever gave you, even if you ignored it at the time?
followUps: Did you ever tell them they were right?

en.question: When a friend is about to make a big mistake, how honest should you be?
followUps: Has anyone ever done that for you?
What would you want this group to tell you to your face?
